messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-3.1.0 is released and on pypi
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] rpy2-3.1.0 is released and on pypi
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Rpy2-3.1.0 is released and on pypi. If using the latest ggplot2 release,
multithreading, or pandas with NA values for integers or dates that's an
update you'll want to make now. A more complete changelog is in the doc as
usual: https://rpy2.github.io/doc/v3.1.x/html/changes.html#relase-3-1-0

L.

messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-3.2.0 is released and on pypi
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] rpy2-3.2.0 is released and on pypi
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-3.2.0 is released and on pypi. This fixes UTF-8 strings in R code, and
adds an optional #cffi API-mode interface to R. The list of changes is
here: https://rpy2.github.io/doc/v3.2.x/html/changes.html#release-3-2-0

Best,

Laurent
